title: MarkdownRetirementPolicy
description: Rebaselined policy for retiring hand-authored Markdown. README.md, CLAUDE.md, and AGENTS.md survive as root authority/entry hubs; HANDOFF.md survives under the founder 2026-06-08 bounded exception as a thin fresh-session redirect. Other Markdown is either a tool-required transitional source/projection or retirement corpus sequenced only through MPV2-0003. Retired content is deleted from candidate HEAD after successor extraction; Git object history is the sole content store.

honest_gaps: Some Markdown semantic content (prose explanations, narrative ADR Context sections) does not naturally project to JSON without loss. Mitigation: extract current structured obligations, then record predecessor Git blob OID and SHA-256 in a neutral closure receipt. Do not retain a readable current-tree copy.

Existing tooling (rustdoc, mdbook, IDE Markdown previews) is markdown-aware. Replacement tooling (JSON-rendering UIs, generated HTML from JSON) is foundation-prerequisite per Wave 1 docs portal v7 + ADR-0066.
External-facing docs (anything published to https://docs.oyatie.com) is foundation-side; this policy covers repo-internal docs only. Public docs site can render from JSON via Leptos SSR per ADR-0065.
The 2026-05-13 phase dates and corpus estimates are historical and stale; this 2026-07-13 rebaseline delegates all executable sequencing to MPV2-0003.
The checked-in DOC-CATALOG projection is not backed by the promised live machine-catalog gate; PHASE-5 promotion remains blocked.
